weapons.has: per weapon id: flash style + scale, tracer, casing and ejection, `special` (a specials style); flash atlas, tracer styles, casing feel

impacts.has: per surface material: impact flipbook, particles (spark, dust, chip), decals

explosions.has: flipbooks (frag, rocket) and styles per explosive: radius, shockwave, light, debris, dust, scorch, camera shake; launchTrail

specials.has: flame stream, beam, EMP orb and burst, saw blade, rounds in flight, riot-shield hits and cracks

projectiles.has: rocket, grenade round and saw blade meshes in projectiles.glb (muzzle frame), trail point, spin

conventions.units: metres and milliseconds unless a key says otherwise (S = seconds, Mps = m/s, Rps = turns/s)
conventions.atlases: cells are numbered row-major from the top left; `anchorUV` / `originU` have v from the top
conventions.tints: sRGB hex; white textures are meant to be tinted
conventions.provisional: a `provisional` key marks numbers taken from docs/03 until packages/content has them
